title: How a composer works: melody like a cyclone
summary: A tune builds up and comes out of his fingers; he does not labor or rewrite, and never wakes in the night with a song.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: JC, I know how my work and my art form, which is theatre; educational theatre for young people -- I take a need and something I want to get across to kids, and then it's a lot of hard work, because you're working with lots of people to bring it to realization.
Yes.
Well, how does a composer work? How do you work? When you write a melody, or when you write a tune, as you call it, how does it, you know, where does it come from?
Well, it forms itself. You see, it's kind of like a cyclone, like that.
Like what?
Cyclone.
Like a cyclone, that's a nice way to put it.
Keeps building up within you, see.
Uh huh.
And it comes out of the tips of your fingers.
Uh huh.
You just sit down, and the things is building up in you and you just play.
Do you ...
You don't make labor out of it, or you've got nothing.
No, I know -- I know that it's just got to come, it's just got to be natural.
Natural and spontaneous, and let it go -- and if not, then just try something else.

In other words, you don't have to re-write, you don't rewrite. Like in theatre, you're always rewriting and writing because you're taking actors, it's a whole different form, it's a whole different art form.

Right. Only think I rewrite are a few poems in that darn book there. I look at them sometimes and I say, 'Oh, that shouldn't be like that' and I make a correction here - and that's about the only thing.
Oh, is that the book you showed me?
Yeah, yeah.
Oh, good. We may include in that there.
Oh, no! We don't need that.
No, it's important! Seriously. All right, so how about it -- did you ever wake up in the middle of the night with a song?
No. A lot of people say they do, but I've never -- when I wake up in the middle of the night, I just have to go to the bathroom and get back in bed!
Son of a gun! Great, great. All right. So -- as anything, you know, it flows, your composition just flows -- when are you going to do some more composing?
